scientific_boundaries.result: Dossier includes CIA archive proposals of tachyons and reverse information flow, technical objections and Ukrainian archival UAP reports. It explicitly reports no direct tachyon detection and no empirical Ukraine-UAP bridge.
EYE benchmark explicitly makes UAP bridge H5 unavailable and carrier-specific H4 mandatory. Apply competing ordinary, information and physical model families to UAP only after measurement gates.

Tachyon Star transfers isolated A/B/C cadence idea to real sky surveys; Palomar and POSS-I concern candidate transients, detector and observing-schedule controls. T1: 0 isolated B events in 8 qualified, 1 unresolved; T2: 0 isolated B in 20 sensitivity-qualified, 8 unresolved.

Traveler separates target, execution, write, Git and observer time; Phoenix Lights separates report date, local event time, UTC, observer locality and inferred object position. One-second early recorded Git timestamp unreplicated; arrival-order inversion not physical reversal.

Retro-SHA had no match and no physical channel; Deutsch v2 blind both models 131/256, one-sided p=.377365; 0/32 exact bytes, both Brier worse than uniform. UAP needs pre-event commitments, not retrospective selection; a verified FAA row is not prediction evidence.

SIMPTOMAT 1296 synthetic vectors, 704/8640 neighbor label flips, 532 unstable vectors; distinct latent mechanisms may yield identical counts. DemiHead R5D public text corpora do not qualify as authenticated physical witness holdout. UAP eyewitness reports similarly do not identify unique causes without independent data.

Tachyon Star defines new windows without nuclear events and retains old schedule confound. UAP archive records no nuclear causation; Phoenix Lights 1997 lacks a recorded Nevada nuclear explosive test in that year. Do not treat nuclear events as carrier or trigger by default.
Official FAA XLSX row 50 records orange-white UAS and preliminary damage unknown. This is an ordinary aviation-report comparator, not a tachyon candidate.
